chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Uthman, from a number of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

He was asked about a man who acquired a slave girl from the war booty (al-fay') and copulated with her before it was distributed. He (peace be upon him) said: 'The slave girl is evaluated and handed over to him at the price, and what his share was from the war booty is deducted for him from that price. He is whipped with the hadd (penalty), and the hadd is deferred from him by the measure of what was his share in her.' So I said, 'And how did the slave girl come to be handed over to him at the price, while others are not?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Because he copulated with her, and it is not feared that she might be pregnant.'

key_terms.الْفَيْء: War booty or spoils of war
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ الْحَدَّ: He is whipped with the hadd (legal penalty)

ai.seo_question: What is the fiqh ruling for a man who has intercourse with a slave girl from war booty before distribution?
ai.summary: In this ruling from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) addresses the specific case of a man consummating relations with a slave girl from the communal war booty (fay') prior to its distribution. The Imam mandates that the girl be valued and transferred to him, with her share of the booty deducted from her price, while he receives the hadd penalty, partially deferred based on his ownership share to mitigate the uncertainty of paternity (shubha). This highlights the Shia juristic principle of balancing property rights within the communal treasury against individual marital rights and lineage preservation.
